policy_rows.selected: {"consequence":"The steward checks understanding after members have explored the space at their own pace.","decision":"How should a new member learn the studio routine?","mechanism":"New members follow the illustrated guide through the studio and then explain the routine to the steward."}

{"consequence":"Earlier access changes between booking rounds while members still choose among the sessions available to them.","decision":"How should members obtain bench time?","mechanism":"The steward publishes a rotating order for members to claim bench sessions on the booking sheet."}

{"consequence":"The plan reflects what the trial reveals about the project’s immediate needs.","decision":"How should a member prepare a project plan?","mechanism":"Members begin with a small sample and then record the next task, materials, and stopping point on a project card."}

{"consequence":"Other members can locate borrowed tools directly and know who is responsible for returning them.","decision":"How should shared hand tools be checked out?","mechanism":"Members write their names on the sign-out line before removing shared hand tools from the numbered hooks."}

{"consequence":"A shared explanation can resolve several similar difficulties within one short consultation.","decision":"How should requests for project help be handled?","mechanism":"Members mark their project questions by topic on the help list, and the steward gathers people with related questions."}

{"consequence":"A regular inventory combines several small shortages into one considered replenishment decision.","decision":"How should shared consumables be replenished?","mechanism":"The steward counts shared consumables at the end of each opening day and updates the restock card before ordering."}

{"consequence":"Materials become available immediately, with the person who created them doing the initial sorting work.","decision":"How should usable offcuts enter the shared scrap supply?","mechanism":"Members place usable offcuts directly into the labeled scrap containers after comparing them with the examples."}

{"consequence":"A central placement record makes projects easy to locate without changing each member’s storage allowance.","decision":"How should unfinished projects be stored between sessions?","mechanism":"The steward assigns an available shelf position when members present packed unfinished projects with review dates."}

{"consequence":"People close to the sound have time to pause sensitive work before the task begins.","decision":"How should short noisy tasks be coordinated?","mechanism":"Members announce a short noisy task at the designated station and wait for nearby members to acknowledge the notice."}

{"consequence":"The person preparing the project records when it can move, giving later users a clear basis for planning.","decision":"How should projects use the drying rack?","mechanism":"Members choose an empty drying-rack space and attach the handling-time tag when placing a wet project there."}

{"consequence":"Shared effort makes overlooked scraps and tools easier to notice while both benches receive the same checklist.","decision":"How should bench cleanup be organized?","mechanism":"Members working nearby pair up to clean one bench and then the other during their final session minutes."}

{"consequence":"The steward receives both the isolated tool and firsthand observations when arranging its inspection.","decision":"How should a damaged tool be reported?","mechanism":"Members place damaged tools in the marked tray and complete repair cards describing what happened during use."}

{"consequence":"Questions already interrupting projects become the basis for a shared lesson that may prevent repeated consultations.","decision":"How should a short technique demonstration be selected?","mechanism":"The steward chooses a weekly technique from recurring help requests and invites members to the demonstration corner."}

{"consequence":"A shared occasion concentrates handovers and allows questions about materials before recipients accept the stated conditions.","decision":"How should personally owned surplus materials be shared?","mechanism":"The steward collects labeled surplus offers for a weekly exchange period when owners and interested members can meet."}

{"consequence":"The steward can identify who still needs an explanation without repeating the update to every arriving member.","decision":"How should members receive changes to studio routines?","mechanism":"Members read dated updates on the notice board and mark an acknowledgment beside their names before starting work."}

{"consequence":"The record is built from shared observations, so the incoming steward sees the conditions behind each follow-up.","decision":"How should unfinished studio duties pass between stewards?","mechanism":"Both stewards make a brief circuit of the studio and record unresolved duties together on the handover pad."}
